translations.web: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
translations.bsb: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.
translations.kjv: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
translations.asv: to whom he said, This is the rest, give ye rest to him that is weary; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
